subject.title: docs(cli): generate and guard command reference

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed public command-catalog CLI and plugin descriptor metadata as a core contract before accepting this generated reference?
rationale: The branch documents and guards a new public CLI and plugin API while the RFC and prerequisite drafts remain unapproved.

options.title: Review foundation first
options.body: Pause this slice until the foundation contract is accepted, then restack it and complete the freshness dependency set.

options.title: Sponsor the full stack
options.body: Approve the command-catalog direction and review the prerequisite PRs in dependency order before this documentation slice.

options.title: Decline the core surface
options.body: Keep command inventory outside the public core CLI and plugin contract and close the stacked proposals.

recommendation.title: Review foundation first
recommendation.body: Pause this slice until the foundation contract is accepted, then restack it and complete the freshness dependency set.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history and CODEOWNERS connect this owner to the affected detector and CLI surfaces, and the protected maintainer label requires repository-owner handling.
